aboutPreview: Native iPhone app in development. It does not have every function of the published app yet.
biometricNeedsSetup: Face ID or Touch ID is not set up on this device.
discoverySteps:
1. Check that the phone uses the workshop Wi-Fi.
2. Check that the server is on.
3. Type its address.
errBadAddress: The address or the port is not valid.
errNoAnswer: The server did not answer. Check the address, the port and the network.
errSessionEnded: The session ended. Sign in again.
errStopNotConfirmed: STOP not confirmed by the server: press it again or use the physical E-stop
errStopSessionEnded: STOP not confirmed and the session ended. Use the physical emergency stop.
errTlsFailed: No secure connection to the server. If its certificate is self-signed, trust it under Security; if it only speaks plain HTTP, allow plain HTTP there.
firstRunFindText: On the same Wi-Fi as the server
firstRunStopText: At the top of every screen, also over windows and menus. One tap, no confirmation. It does not replace the physical emergency stop.
helpText: At home or in the workshop, join the same Wi-Fi as the server and search the network. From outside, use your VPN and type the address of the server. A server with its own certificate needs its fingerprint in the security settings.
loginCantConnect: Cannot connect? How to reach your server
loginCodeHint: Six digits from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
loginCodeNeeded: This account uses a second step. Enter the code from your authenticator app.
loginCodeWait: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
loginCodeWrong: That code is not right. Try the next one from the app, or use a recovery code.
loginScanNoneFound: No servers found on this network.
loginScanSkipMobileVpn: Do not scan mobile-data or VPN networks
moreChangeServerText: The session of this one stays on the phone
notYet: Not in this version yet. Use the published app for this.
pairingCameraUnavailable: The camera is not available. Paste the link instead.
pairingDialogPinReplace: Accepting sets the connection to require TLS and pins this certificate, replacing the fingerprint kept before.
pairingProblemFingerprint: The certificate fingerprint of the link is not valid.
pairingProblemGeneric: The pairing link is not valid.
pairingProblemHost: The pairing link has no valid server address.
pairingProblemName: The name in the pairing link is not valid.
pairingProblemNoFingerprint: The pairing link has no certificate fingerprint, so it cannot be used. Generate a new link on the admin page of the server.
pairingProblemNotLink: That is not a pairing link.
pairingProblemPort: The pairing link has no valid port.
pairingSwitchHint: The admin page of the server shows a QR code with its address and certificate fingerprint. Scan it with the phone camera, or paste the link here. The app shows what it read and asks before it keeps anything. Off by default.
pairingSwitchLabel: Allow pairing by QR code or link
robotsNone: No robot read from the server yet.
securityAllowPlain: Allow plain HTTP when HTTPS is not available
securityAllowPlainSubtitle: Only for servers on your local network.
securityAllowRemote: Also allow plain HTTP outside the local network
securityAllowRemoteSubtitle: The session token would travel readable across the Internet. Leave it off unless a trusted tunnel protects the link.
securityFetchFailed: No TLS connection could be made to {server}.
securityFingerprintInvalid: The fingerprint must be 64 hexadecimal digits.
securityIntro: The app connects over HTTPS. Plain HTTP is used only if you allow it below.
securityNeedsHost: Enter the host and port of the server first.
settingsRequireBiometricSubtitle: Ask again on launch before reconnecting to a saved session
stopAllNotSaved: The stop is applied, but the server could not save it.
stopAllRobotByRobot: Stopped robot by robot (the global stop was not available).
stopPhysical: This app does not replace the physical emergency stop.
